name: Trial Marriage to A Billionaire
overview: At the height of her modeling career, Aurora gives up everything for the man she loves, only to be abandoned on her wedding day after discovering he has gotten another woman pregnant. Determined not to be broken by heartbreak, she impulsively proposes to Mason Hughes, the city’s wealthiest and most powerful bachelor, whose own bride has failed to appear. To her surprise, he agrees, and the two enter a secret six-month marriage arrangement. As they navigate their unconventional union, trust, attraction, and hidden feelings begin to grow, turning a marriage of convenience into something neither expected.
